description: Convert type layers (Type menu): to paragraph or point type, to a shape layer (Convert to Shape), to a work path (Create Work Path, which replaces the current work path), or to a selection shaped like the text, as the Type Mask tools make

combine.description: selection: how the text outline combines with the current selection. Default replace

removeLayer.description: selection: delete the type layers afterwards, leaving only the selection (as the Type Mask tools do). Default false

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

to.description: What to convert the type into

name: convert_type_layer
title: Convert Type Layer
